# CodexOshi

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**Your favorite character, right beside Codex.** A desktop companion that shows your remaining quota and local token usage.

[Download for Windows](https://github.com/Chester-chs/CodexOshi/releases/latest) · [User guide](docs/guide.md)

## What you can do

- See remaining quota and the reset countdown at a glance.
- View local token usage for the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days.
- Upload your favorite anime or game character; **transparent chibis or portraits work best**.
- Customize colors, dialogue and click sounds.
- Drag or pin the companion, resize it, or show just the quota bar.

## Install

For **Windows x64 with Codex desktop installed and signed in**. Installation needs internet access.

1. Download **CodexOshi-Setup-*-win-x64.exe** from [Releases](https://github.com/Chester-chs/CodexOshi/releases/latest).
2. Run it and wait for installation to finish. **No separate Node.js or Git installation needed.**
3. Fully quit and reopen Codex, then start a new chat. Click the companion's gear to set it up.

Already have **Node.js 24+, npm and Git**? Download **CodexOshi-Node24-Git-*.zip**, extract it and run **Install-CodexOshi.cmd** instead.

Already installed? Use **CodexOshi Settings → Quota → Check for updates → Update now**.

*The installer is unsigned, so Windows may display a trust warning.*

### Let Codex install it

Paste this into a local Codex chat:

```text
Install CodexOshi on this Windows computer: https://github.com/Chester-chs/CodexOshi.
Use the latest Release and verify SHA256SUMS.txt. If already installed, update it while preserving my characters and settings.
Check that the companion appears; ask me to restart Codex if needed.
```

## Quick controls

- **Gear:** settings, character uploads and the on/off switch.
- **Pin:** toggle fixed placement; highlighted means pinned.
- **Character:** open dialogue. Click the bubble for the next line.
- **Keyboard:** `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` to navigate, `Enter` / `Space` to activate, `Esc` to close settings. [All shortcuts](docs/guide.md#settings-keyboard-shortcuts)

Images stay on your computer. Token charts cover local sessions, not account-wide totals. CodexOshi reads usage without generating model replies and **never spends reset credits**. Use artwork you have permission to use.
